tips.title: DON'T GRIND YET
tips.body: Cash you carry is lost when Chapter 1 ends. Only Family Savings stays, so push the story.

tips.title: SELL CARS TO MOSES
tips.body: Moses buys untracked stolen cars. Damage lowers the price; his requested cars pay a condition bonus.

tips.title: ROB JEWELRY STORES
tips.body: Yasmani pays well for stolen jewelry. Each store is worth $10,000 to $25,000.

tips.title: RANDY'S WISH LIST
tips.body: Randy pays up to ~$30,000 for Wish List supercars in perfect condition. Damage lowers the price.

tips.title: HIT THE BANK VAULTS
tips.body: Large bank vaults pay up to $205,000 each. The best money in Leonida, but you get an instant 4-star wanted level.

tips.title: USE FAMILY SAVINGS
tips.body: Hit the $5,000 Family Savings goal and BuckMe pays interest. Savings can't be withdrawn, but they're safe.

caption:
GTA 6 money guide 💰 The fastest legit ways to make money in Grand Theft Auto 6 story mode, chapter by chapter: sell untracked cars to Moses from Chapter 2, rob jewelry stores for $10,000 to $25,000 each, deliver Randy's Wish List supercars for up to ~$30,000 and hit the bank vaults for up to $205,000.
